meta.title: Real Estate Website Proposal | PROPERTYMAN CONSULT
meta.description: Website development and property lead-generation proposal for real estate agencies in Ghana.

hero.eyebrow: Property websites · Digital growth · Lead generation
hero.headline: A stronger digital presence for your real estate business.
hero.subheading: A practical website proposal designed to help buyers, tenants, investors, and property owners discover your listings and contact your team.

sections.heading: The business opportunity
sections.subheading: A website should do more than look professional. It should help generate inquiries.
sections.introSuffix: thank you for considering us as a digital partner. We propose a mobile-friendly real estate website that presents your agency professionally, makes properties easy to explore, and gives interested prospects a clear path to contact your team.

outcomes.title: Build trust
outcomes.body: Showcase your company, team, properties, and contact information professionally.

outcomes.title: Make listings easier to find
outcomes.body: Organize properties by location, type, price, and sale or rental status where included.

outcomes.title: Convert interest into inquiries
outcomes.body: Use WhatsApp links, inquiry forms, and viewing requests where included.

sections.heading: Start with a free offer
sections.subheading: A low-risk way to experience our thinking before committing to development.

cards.title: Property Visibility Check
cards.body: A short review of your existing online presence to identify practical opportunities.
items: Review of your website or public business profile
Three prioritized improvement recommendations
15-minute feedback call
Suggested next step based on your budget

cards.title: Sample Property Page Preview
cards.body: A simple visual concept to show how one of your listings could be presented online.
items: One static homepage section or property-detail concept
Uses one sample property and information you provide
One presentation of the concept
No functional website or production code included

sections.footer: Free offers are limited to the items listed above, subject to availability and qualification. They do not include a live website, domain, hosting, paid advertising, or ongoing technical support. No purchase is required.

sections.heading: Choose your main website package
sections.subheading: We keep the main choice simple. Start with the package that fits your current needs, then add advanced features as your business grows.

tiers.title: Starter Presence
tiers.desc: For a small agency that needs a credible online presence and a clear way for customers to get in touch.
items: Up to 5 standard pages
Responsive, mobile-friendly design
Featured property showcase and dedicated property-detail pages
Sale and rental categories
Initial upload of up to 20 properties
Self-service property dashboard to add, edit, and remove listings without developer help
Search by location, property type, price, and sale/rent status
Featured and recently added listings
Maps integration
WhatsApp contact links and basic inquiry form
Basic property inquiry details sent to the agency
Social links and basic on-page SEO
2 revision rounds
14 days of post-launch bug support
tiers.footNote: Includes self-service listing management and core property discovery tools. Agent profiles, viewing-request workflows, and enhanced lead tools are available in Property Growth.

tiers.title: Property Growth
tiers.desc: For an active agency that wants to manage listings and make it easier for clients to find the right property.
items: Everything in Starter Presence
Increase initial property upload allowance to up to 30 properties
Property-specific inquiry forms and viewing request form
Up to 3 agent profile pages
Email notifications for new inquiries
Analytics setup and basic performance tracking
Basic administrator training
30 days of post-launch bug support

enterprise.heading: Not ready to invest yet?
enterprise.body: Start with our free Property Visibility Check or request a sample property-page preview. We will give you useful recommendations and suggest a practical next step for your budget.

sections.heading: Optional upgrade packages
sections.subheading: Start with either main package, then add these upgrades when your agency is ready. Upgrade prices are added to the price of your selected main package, not standalone website prices.

tiers.title: Agency Professional Upgrade
tiers.desc: Add stronger agent and lead-management tools to your chosen Starter Presence or Property Growth website.
items: Everything in your selected main package
Increase initial upload allowance to up to 75 properties
Expand agent profiles to up to 10 agents
Assign listings to individual agents
Lead inquiry management dashboard
Enhanced property filters
Support for supplied property video and virtual-tour links
Enhanced on-page SEO setup
3 revision rounds for the full project
45 days of post-launch bug support

footItems.label: Upgrade fee:
footItems.text: GH₵2,500 added to the selected main package.

footItems.label: Estimated delivery:
footItems.text: Allow 1–2 additional weeks, subject to scope.

tiers.title: Enterprise Property Upgrade
tiers.desc: For agencies that need more control over team access, lead routing, reporting, or connections to existing business tools.
items: Everything in the Agency Professional Upgrade
Multiple staff accounts with agreed permission levels
Advanced property and lead-management workflow
One agreed custom report or management dashboard
One compatible CRM or external API integration, subject to technical review
Lead routing rules for agreed agents or teams
One scoped booking or viewing workflow enhancement
Technical planning for future system or mobile-app expansion

footItems.label: Upgrade fee:
footItems.text: GH₵5,500 added to the selected main package and includes the Agency Professional upgrade features.

tiers.footNote: Third-party fees and work outside the agreed scope are excluded.

sections.smallNote: Upgrade pricing is additional to the GH₵5,000 Starter Presence or GH₵8,000 Property Growth package. For example, Starter + Agency Professional is GH₵7,500; Property Growth + Agency Professional is GH₵10,500. Enterprise Upgrade includes Agency Professional features, so the combined total is GH₵10,500 with Starter or GH₵13,500 with Property Growth. These totals exclude hosting, domain, third-party subscriptions, and any separately approved out-of-scope work.

sections.heading: Main package comparison
sections.subheading: The exact scope will be confirmed in writing before work begins.
rows: Dedicated property-detail pages and sale/rent categories
Self-service dashboard to add, edit, and remove listings
Search by location, type, price, and sale/rent status
Lead dashboard / assign listings to agents
sections.footer: Property upload numbers are initial setup allowances, not necessarily lifetime limits on how many properties the system can hold. Final technical limits depend on the chosen implementation and hosting environment.

sections.heading: Optional services to grow after launch
sections.subheading: Add only what helps your team. These services are scoped separately and are not required to launch the website.

items.title: Website care & security
items.body: Updates, backups, uptime checks, security maintenance, and agreed minor fixes. Available as a recurring service.

items.title: Property listing support
items.body: Monthly upload and updating of property details, images, availability, and prices, based on an agreed volume.

items.title: SEO & local visibility
items.body: Search optimization, location-focused landing pages, and support improving your Google Business Profile presence.

items.title: Social media property promotion
items.body: Property posts, promotional creatives, and campaign support. Advertising spend is paid separately by the client.

items.title: Lead automation & CRM
items.body: Route website inquiries to the right agent, send notifications, and connect compatible CRM or follow-up tools.

items.title: Photography, video & virtual tours
items.body: Property media production or integration with supplied video and virtual-tour services. Any external production cost is quoted separately.

items.title: Mobile app development
items.body: Separate Android and iOS app proposal, including a technical assessment of how the app can share property data with the website.

items.title: Analytics & conversion improvements
items.body: Review visitor activity and inquiry journeys, then recommend changes to help more visitors contact your team.

sections.footer: We will recommend add-ons only where there is a clear business case. Prices, deliverables, and recurring commitments will be agreed before work begins.

sections.heading: How the project works
sections.subheading: Clear milestones help both teams stay aligned.

steps.title: 1. Discover
steps.body: Confirm goals, content, property volume, required features, and the selected package.

steps.title: 2. Design & build
steps.body: Approve the visual direction, then develop the agreed pages and functionality.

steps.title: 3. Test & launch
steps.body: Review core functionality, approve launch, and receive the agreed handover and training.

sections.heading: Investment and project terms
sections.subheading: Transparent costs and clear boundaries from the start.

terms.title: Payment schedule
terms.body: Suggested milestones: 50% upfront, 30% after the agreed main functionality is demonstrated, and 20% before final handover and launch.

terms.title: Hosting and domain excluded
terms.body: Hosting, domain registration, business email, paid plugins or APIs, and other third-party charges are not included in development fees. We will confirm these costs before purchase.

terms.title: Content and approvals
terms.body: The client supplies accurate property details, prices, images, branding, and authorized contact information. Delays in content or approvals can affect delivery dates.

terms.title: Changes and support
terms.body: Features outside the agreed scope are quoted separately and require approval. Included bug support covers defects in delivered functionality, not new features or ongoing content updates.

terms.title: Ownership and third-party tools
terms.body: After full payment, the client receives the agreed custom deliverables and website content, subject to third-party licenses and service terms.

terms.title: Maintenance after launch
terms.body: Ongoing updates, backups, security checks, content uploads, and technical maintenance can be arranged under a separate monthly or annual plan.

sections.calloutBody: Prices are development estimates for the scope listed. Applicable taxes, if any, will be stated separately. The final scope, delivery dates, and payment milestones will be confirmed in a written agreement before work starts.

sections.heading: Let's find the right fit
sections.subheading: No pressure to choose the biggest package. Let's start with your business needs.
paragraphs: We recommend Property Growth at GH₵8,000 for agencies that want to manage listings themselves and turn property interest into direct inquiries. Starter Presence at GH₵5,000 already includes dedicated property pages, sale/rental categories, and basic inquiry capture. Agencies can add Agency Professional for GH₵2,500 or the Enterprise upgrade for GH₵5,500 when they need more advanced tools. If you are not ready to invest yet, start with our free visibility check.
To proceed, reply with your preferred package or request the free Property Visibility Check. We can then confirm your requirements and prepare the final scope.
